facts.anchor: “Brothers.” She blew a raspberry. “They should have zero say in our love lives.”

Fucking “no strings.” I should’ve never agreed to that rule.

facts.fact: 水下十指相扣：一秒治愈全场焦虑
facts.anchor: She laced her fingers with mine, giving my hand a squeeze. And I no longer felt so stressed about…well, anything really.

facts.fact: Gabe（金童）借冰雕杯酒放风——做回凡人
facts.anchor: As hockey’s golden boy, he had a reputation to maintain.

facts.fact: 她的自我盘点：整晚高能，快烧起来了

facts.fact: 她的半个告白：All I need is you
facts.anchor: “You.” My breath hitched, my feelings hitting me full force. My touch softened, and I cupped his cheek. “All I need is you.”

facts.fact: 她意识到：真正裸露的不是身体是心
facts.anchor: I was baring my heart to him. I was admitting just how much I needed him.

facts.fact: 规则的真相：为自保而生，遇上Carson全数失效
facts.anchor: I’d made the rules to protect myself, but when it came to Carson, all bets were off.

facts.fact: 他的占有宣言：回场后你记得你是我的
facts.anchor: “—I want you to come on my face so that when we return to the party, you won’t be able to look at me without thinking of this moment. Without remembering that you’re mine.”
